added.statement: The Home Manager activation shall disable the legacy jcode-lane-settle timer, stop an already-running legacy service, and remove its exact timer, service, and script paths before Home Manager reloads user systemd.
acceptance_criteria: activation contains systemctl --user stop jcode-lane-settle.service after timer disable and before file removal
the hook is ordered before reloadSystemd

ears.trigger: a switch activates the managed dotfiles generation
ears.response: disable the timer, stop any running legacy service, and retire the exact legacy lane-settle user artifacts before systemd reload

breaker.condition: the named timer remains enabled, the timer or service remains active, or any named legacy artifact remains after activation

added.statement: The retirement hook shall not invoke an Engine workspace lifecycle operation.
acceptance_criteria: the hook contains no workspace-recover, workspace-close, workspace-release, or workspace-abandon command
activation scope is limited to the three named legacy files and user-systemd state

ears.response: must not mutate an Engine workspace or its lease

breaker.condition: the activation hook contains a workspace lifecycle command or targets an unlisted user path

test_plan.description: Focused Node test fails until the exact retirement hook disables the timer, stops the service, and validates its ordering and exact paths.
The same focused test rejects workspace lifecycle commands in the retirement hook.
A Home Manager switch proves timer disabled, both timer and service inactive, and exact legacy artifacts absent.

A real detect-secrets scan filters only exact canonical sha256 digest objects in purpose.contract.json, work.spec.json, and evidence.bundle.json; uppercase, non-digest, and wrong-filename entropy remain findings.

commands: ! systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet jcode-lane-settle.timer; ! systemctl --user is-active --quiet jcode-lane-settle.timer; ! systemctl --user is-active --quiet jcode-lane-settle.service; test ! -e $HOME/.config/systemd/user/jcode-lane-settle.timer; test ! -e $HOME/.config/systemd/user/jcode-lane-settle.service; test ! -e $HOME/.local/bin/jcode-lane-settle.sh

dependencies: JCode terminal lane cleanup source fix
